purpose: Dallas NFL Gamecast animation sequencing, scene handoff and deterministic recovery contract for production chibi playback.

sequenceController.authority: Authoritative Gamecast play truth plus roster.json action inventory determines every sequence; file presence never grants action eligibility.
sequenceController.transitionRule: Transitions occur only at authored blend windows or authoritative interruption boundaries; polling refreshes cannot advance a sequence twice.
sequenceController.resultHold: Use a short bounded result hold so completed catches, tackles, sacks and scores read clearly without blocking the next authoritative play.
sequenceController.recovery: Every sequence resolves to the player's canonical bottom-center foot anchor and neutral orientation before ownership returns to idle.
sequenceController.newPlayPreemption: A newer authoritative play preempts result holds and nonessential recovery after a safe blend, while preserving identity and football truth.
sequenceController.clock: Use one monotonic play-scoped clock shared with multi-participant choreography; never derive animation progress from polling arrival time.

handoff.samePlayer: When one player owns consecutive authored actions, preserve the rendered identity instance and blend between eligible clips rather than despawn/respawn.
handoff.participantChange: Outgoing principals finish or blend out before incoming principals claim the same visual lane unless an authored contact/transfer overlap requires both.
handoff.football: Football ownership is transferred at one authoritative authored boundary and is never duplicated during scene handoff.
handoff.camera: Scene handoff cannot alter the shared locked Gamecast camera, player-specific scale projection or stadium lighting rig.
handoff.signature: A verified signature may follow its qualifying result only once per authoritative event key and must yield immediately to correction or newer-play truth.

deterministicRecovery.assetDecodeFailure: Keep the existing non-chibi Gamecast representation; do not substitute another player's asset or synthesize appearance.
deterministicRecovery.missingAction: Use that resolved player's safe base/idle asset only when roster-authoritative identity is available.
deterministicRecovery.midSequenceFailure: Release football ownership back to authoritative Gamecast state, clear transient root motion and remove the failed chibi at a safe frame boundary.
deterministicRecovery.correction: Invalidate sequence state for the corrected play, clear consumed signature/event markers for invalidated revisions only, and rebuild from corrected truth.
deterministicRecovery.reconnect: After visibility/network recovery, reconstruct only the latest authoritative play state; do not replay intermediate polling snapshots.
deterministicRecovery.crossTeam: A DAL sequence can resolve only DAL roster identities; stable player id plus team namespace is required.

visualInvariants.appearanceAuthority: current official Dallas headshot lock; never infer skin tone or visible appearance from name
visualInvariants.mirroring: Never mirror jersey numbers, lettering or identity-specific visible details.

checks: Sequence progression is deterministic and independent of polling cadence.
Consecutive actions preserve player identity without visual respawn flicker.
Every sequence returns to canonical foot anchor without accumulating root motion.
Football authority remains singular through handoffs, failures and interruptions.
Decode/missing-action recovery never guesses identity or appearance.
Only verified Dallas signature concepts can enter the signature state.
Camera, lighting, scale, number, alpha and official-headshot appearance locks remain invariant.
No MLB/NHL runtime or metadata dependency is introduced.
